findings.observation: Observed in the exact requested workspace: current maps.js still documents that its scenes reference the source game’s official map artwork, names distinctive scene elements, and retains four source-themed map descriptions. props.js still contains source-sign text. Most concretely, workspace/source/qq-speed/src/layouts.js is byte-identical to the pinned upstream layouts.js (SHA-256 5d2fbfc2f6f28b1c5d8c4646d12f149d057e2d305fd598a5387ea10f674b4b35), so the route control-point geometry remains unchanged. The attempt-10 startup screenshot shows the city environment in the output. Inference: visible name substitutions do not remove the source route layout and scene dressing. The protectability and ownership of particular elements have not been independently determined; this remains a commercial-clearance blocker, not a conclusion on legal ownership.
